en: A black and white postcard showing a historical military parade with soldiers in uniform marching through a cobblestone street. The street is packed with onlookers, and the event appears to take place in front of a grand, ornately decorated building. Banners and flags hang from the building and poles, and there is a large crowd gathered to witness the event. The image has an old, early 20th-century photographic style.
